jobs.title: Create a calendar event the operator asked for

variants.input: Put lunch with Ana on my calendar for Friday at noon.
variants.expected: One event, Friday 12:00-13:00, titled lunch with Ana; the reply names it.

variants.input: Book the dentist for the 14th at 9.
variants.expected: One event on the 14th at 09:00; nothing else changed.
One event Tuesday morning; the reply states the hours it chose.

jobs.title: Follow up when no relevant reply arrived

variants.input: If ContactB has not answered about the invoice by tomorrow, nudge them.
variants.expected: One follow-up after the deadline with no relevant reply; none if one arrived.

variants.input: Chase the venue if they go quiet.
variants.expected: The identity asks which venue and what counts as quiet, or says it cannot tell.

variants.input: Remind Lee about the contract if they do not reply by Thursday.
variants.expected: One follow-up after Thursday only if no relevant reply.

negative_cases.description: The send needs approval and none is given: nothing is sent, and the identity says it is waiting.
negative_cases.input: Email ContactB right now that the invoice is overdue, no need to check with me.

negative_cases.description: Asked to delete an event that does not exist: no other event is touched, and the identity says it found none.
negative_cases.input: Delete my 3pm with Priya on Wednesday.
